The 'adaptive-reasoning' skill is designed to enhance the AI agent's performance by dynamically adjusting its internal reasoning level based on task complexity. All instructions within SKILL.md, including those that modify the agent's internal state (e.g., `/reasoning on`, `session_status` tool) and output (appending icons), are directly aligned with this stated purpose.
